Manage macOS restore images.

```text
pomme ipsw SUBCOMMAND
```

## pomme ipsw list

List available restore images.

```text
pomme ipsw list [--device DEVICE] [--limit LIMIT] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--device DEVICE` | Apple silicon Mac identifier. Defaults to the host model. |
| `--limit LIMIT` | Maximum number of results. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme ipsw download

Download a restore image.

```text
pomme ipsw download SELECTION [--device DEVICE] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `SELECTION` | macOS version, build, or `latest`. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--device DEVICE` | Apple silicon Mac identifier. Defaults to the host model. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).
